name: mirage
text: Read the new v1.0.127 report (16:04 your time). Better: slow idle frames fell from 64% to 39%, and the Engine tab from 94% to 25% slow. Still bad: the +EV tab (every frame slow) and the first start after the update took 18 s, which is expected once, since Android compiles the new profile after the first run: the next starts should be shorter. Closing itself right after an update is Android restarting the app for the new version, not a crash (none recorded). Your two messages did arrive here (21:06 and 21:08), and GitHub connections were healthy, so 'sending again' is the screen not updating its status, not a lost message. I'm now working on the +EV tab and that stuck status.
